title: Switch the Clock to 24-hour time
description: Live tour: add a Clock widget and turn on 24H Format in its settings.

steps.label: Open Tools
steps.text: Click **Open Tools** to open the dock.

steps.label: Clock
steps.text: Click **Clock** to add a clock to your board.

steps.label: Settings button
steps.text: Click the **Settings** gear on the clock's toolbar.

steps.label: 24H Format
steps.text: Turn on **24H Format** if it is off, then click Next. Hours run from 0 to 23 with no AM or PM.

steps.label: Close settings
steps.text: Click the X to close settings. The clock keeps your change.

steps.label: 24-hour clock
steps.text: Afternoon hours now read 13 to 23 instead of 1 to 11 PM.

welcomeMessage: Switch a Clock widget to 24-hour time.
